name: KyungJun Lee
headline: A UX leader who designs AI experiences and works with AI
summary: Principal UX Designer with 21 years at Samsung Electronics — 9 as a software engineer, 12 in UX — turning complex technology into experiences anyone can use. Now leading GenAI chatbot UX and AI-driven design automation. Built Samsung's first Digital Twin and spatial IoT products from 0 to 1, with 6+ global design awards and 13+ granted patents. Finds business opportunities through research and steps into the UX PM role when needed.

numbers.label: Global design awards
numbers.note: Red Dot · iF · IDEA · Good Design and more

competencies.title: AI UX & design automation
competencies.body: Designed GenAI chatbot UX and architecture, now sold as a SmartThings Pro feature. Building PRD-to-Figma UI guide automation with Claude and Figma MCP, AI-ready tokens and AI translation guidelines.

competencies.title: Complex B2B spatial UX
competencies.body: Turns 2D plans into 3D maps managing IoT, robots, ships, vehicles and occupancy. Samsung's first Digital Twin now runs Korea's first SmartScore Gold building.

competencies.title: UX research & business strategy
competencies.body: Found B2B opportunities through Korea–US interviews, shadowing and home visits, growing to 130K+ households. As UX researcher, raised adoption from 8% to 12%.

competencies.title: Engineering-driven innovation
competencies.body: Nine years on protocols, GPS and Samsung's first eSIM. Form-factor UX shipped on Galaxy S8 and Fold, the first CES 2018 MDE theme, 13+ patents.

story.title: Depth in technology, as an engineer
story.body: Nine years building mobile protocols, system software and SIM/eSIM. Led Samsung's first eSIM with Sprint and verified in the field across the US, Europe and Asia.

story.title: The human view, in UX
story.body: Moved to UX, covering concept, design and working prototypes on my own. Led the multi-device connection experience (MDE), then found B2B opportunities through Korea–US research and turned them into the smart-apartment business.

story.title: 0→1 and the AI shift, as a Principal
story.body: Built spatial IoT solutions from 0 to 1 — SmartThings Map View, Samsung's first Digital Twin and SmartThings Pro Interactive View. Now leading GenAI chatbot UX and AI-driven design automation.
